instruction:
I notice VLC's background cone icon is distracting when no video is playing. I want to disable the background cone icon in VLC's interface.
How can I turn off this feature?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling VLC's background cone icon (qt-bgcone=0). Uses existing check_qt_bgcone metric function. Expected value is 0 (disabled).
